convert_ade20k_to_coco_panoptic: run the script to convert ADE20K dataset annotations to COCO panoptic format
convert_ade20k_to_coco_instance: run the script with --task instance to convert ADE20K annotations to COCO instance format
prepare_instance_annotations: create COCO instance segmentation JSON annotations from ADE20K instance PNG masks and category mappings
prepare_panoptic_annotations: create COCO panoptic segmentation PNGs and JSON from ADE20K semantic and instance annotations
parse_args: review the argparse configuration that accepts a source data path and optional task name defaulting to panoptic
